neon.additional_branch_and_private_network_co: Excluded from these partial formula inputs; required if a proposed topology uses them.
neon.qualification: Public documented rates, not a procured plan, measured workload, budget authorization or actual invoice.

cloudflare.static_assets_storage_and_direct_asset_r: No extra asset storage charge; direct static requests are free. Worker invocations and Workers Caching request rules must be accounted for separately.
cloudflare.qualification: Published price/limit facts; actual account plan and usage remain unmeasured. No configuration change.

publication_measurement.scope: Calculated from the previously accepted retained-artifact receipt; not a new artifact-byte verification, database size, transfer volume or invoice.

formula_scope.neon_transfer: Use GB transferred during a billing month, not storage GB-month. Apply the included amount per project, not independently per branch.
formula_scope.cloudflare: The account formula includes shared allowances; do not charge an existing minimum again as known project incremental cost.
formula_scope.all: Partial rate inputs cannot establish total cost. Recheck rates and include every used product before a concrete procurement decision.

missing_inputs: actual account plan, usage and invoice
workload CU-hours, database/history/snapshot footprint and transfer
source rights and required retention classes
connection, latency, 2x capacity, recovery and residency requirements
an explicit selected paid budget before paid enrichment or new procurement
